doc: bsv-low #649 N3: the D1 ceilings of the parked set's steps on a 10,000-row fixture (tools/lane-e649/change_park_budget_ci.mjs, make ci-d1-budget), measured on local D1 under wrangler dev on 2026-10-13. The margin is lane 499's: reads x 1.5 rounded up, at least + 4; writes + 2, 0 stays 0; stmts + 2. The drain's 128 reads and 128 writes are the 128 rows it selects and backs off (no transport in the tier); the park of a NEW key on a full table reads its ceiling (2,048).
